name: Giant Eagle
sourceRole: The original adventure supplies the stat block and encounter. The Wizards adventure index confirms the publication identity.
sourceDistinctions: The appendix prints neutral good. The encounter identifies a corrupted specimen and supplies the aerial tactics.
appearanceEvidence: The Aerial Battle on p. 39 describes emaciated flying forms and identifies the corrupted giant eagle among the foes.
habitatEvidence: The Aerial Battle on p. 39 takes place above the treeline near the forest stronghold.

name: Giant Owl
sourceRole: The original adventure supplies the stat block and encounter. The Wizards adventure index confirms the publication identity.
sourceDistinctions: The appendix gives the Giant Owl the same p. 46 folio as the Giant Eagle.
appearanceEvidence: Page 39 describes the aerial interceptors as emaciated and identifies two as giant owls.
habitatEvidence: The Aerial Battle on p. 39 places the giant owls over the forest near the stronghold.

name: Wolf
sourceRole: The original adventure supplies the stat block and encounter. The Wizards adventure index confirms the publication identity.
sourceDistinctions: The adventure gives a corrupted appearance for the encounter and prints the Wolf block with its ordinary abilities.
appearanceEvidence: The Foes and Tactics text across pp. 36–37 gives the details of the corrupted pack’s appearance.
habitatEvidence: The Corrupted Hills encounter on pp. 36–37 places the pack in forest underbrush.

name: Giant Goat
sourceRole: The original adventure supplies the stat block and encounter. The Wizards adventure index confirms the publication identity.
sourceDistinctions: The rules identity is Giant Goat. The travel encounter substitutes bison appearance and herd behavior.
appearanceEvidence: The p. 26 stat block names Giant Goat. The p. 12 encounter explicitly uses it for bison. Goat anatomy is editorial for the base stat block.
habitatEvidence: The bison entry in the p. 12 travel table uses the Giant Goat block in the hills toward Kranun’s Crater.

name: Saber-­‐Toothed Tiger
sourceRole: The original adventure supplies the stat block and encounter. The Wizards adventure index confirms the publication identity.
sourceDistinctions: The printed heading uses an ordinary hyphen. The indexed identity retains the roster’s distinct Unicode punctuation.
Page 29 prints STR 18 (+4) and +6 to hit, with +5 in the damage formula for both attacks. This profile uses the printed formulas.
appearanceEvidence: The printed heading names a saber-toothed tiger. The cat’s build and fang shape are editorial portrait details.
habitatEvidence: The p. 12 travel table places the saber-toothed tigers with stone giants on the way to Kranun’s Crater.
